facts.fact: Communications minister Samuel Nartey George said on 2026-10-21 that the government is building a single national backbone, a national data exchange hub, to connect 48 public registries including the National Identification Authority, Ghana Statistical Service, Births and Deaths Registry and Ghana Police Service.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
